Fit Finder

Size Guide

All measurements are in centimetres (cm). If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a relaxed fit.

How to Measure

Chest

Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape horizontal.

Waist

Measure around your natural waistline, about 2.5 cm above your belly button.

Hips

Stand with feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips.
